---
title: "ssoossh service enroll"
description: "Enroll a service keypair for unattended certificate issuance."
eyebrow: "CLI reference"

<!-- Generated by genclidocs from the cobra command tree in client/cmd. Do not edit. -->

Enrolls a keypair bound by the server to an enrollment code for later certificate retrieval. The keypair is either generated here or already present on disk.

The code is printed once and stored nowhere. Save it where the unattended job that runs `service retrieve` can read it.

The approver picks which of their service accounts the enrollment is for, in their browser. That account is named in this command's output along with when the code stops being redeemable, since it is the sole principal of every certificate the code produces.

The key files follow OpenSSH naming: the private key is &lt;name&gt;, the public key is &lt;name&gt;.pub, and the certificate (once retrieved) is &lt;name&gt;-cert.pub. The three files must be in the same directory for ssh to find them.

With --retrieve, the command immediately redeems the code once, writing the certificate to &lt;name&gt;-cert.pub and reporting its details. If retrieval fails after the code is printed, an error is returned but the code is not lost.

## Synopsis

```
ssoossh service enroll [flags] [args]
```

## Options

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--key` | string |  | keypair path (relative or absolute); generates both if neither &lt;name&gt; nor &lt;name&gt;.pub exist, enrolls the existing &lt;name&gt;.pub otherwise |
| `--retrieve` | bool | `false` | immediately redeem the code and write the certificate to &lt;name&gt;-cert.pub |
